assumptions: S, R, U form a valid context-specific coarse state model
dose-specific transition rates are constant during a pulse
the target is occupancy in R at stop time
U is absorbing during the pulse
rates can be estimated from lineage-resolved data
contract.interface: Fixed context/dose CTMC with S->R rate a, S->U rate c, R->U rate b; optimize pulse length to maximize endpoint R subject to cumulative U risk cap delta.

costs.data: lineage tracking, same-cell target and harm markers, factor-protein time course, independent animal/donor replication, and possible single-cell assays; sample size UNKNOWN without pilot variance
costs.actuation: factor/vector/inducer amount, tissue delivery, pulse and chase exposure, and washout lag
costs.compute: O(D) closed-form score evaluations after estimating rates at D dose levels; extended state/time/action discretization costs must be charged
costs.precision: rate confidence intervals, exposure measurement error, endpoint assay error, and uncertainty from cell/donor heterogeneity

candidate.representation: Three-state CTMC reach-avoid model with rate-calibrated dose strata; use a semi-Markov or richer partially observed state model if holding times/heterogeneity reject the CTMC.
candidate.hypothesis: For a fixed dose/context, endpoint-safe target occupancy is unimodal with T*=log((a+c)/b)/(a+c-b), limit 1/b at equality; the risk-constrained optimum clips this time to the unique cumulative-risk boundary. Actual biological validity is UNKNOWN.

missing_lemma: No acquired biological transition generator links measurable OSK/OSKM exposure to same-cell regenerative/rejuvenation and unsafe-state transitions with uncertainty bounds; without it, the conditional CTMC optimum is not a cell controller.
comparator: Best open-loop dose/duration schedule selected on training data at matched measured factor exposure and delivery cost, validated on held-out animals/donors; also vehicle/injury-only and one prespecified conventional schedule.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Track same-cell lineage/state and OSK protein under a fixed tissue/injury context; estimate a,b,c, predict withheld pulse durations, and reject the model if peak, risk monotonicity, or confidence calibration fails.
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: optimal schedule under true exposure and safety costs
status_note: The analytic CTMC and rate-rescaling statements are reconstructed; biological validity, safety, and novelty remain UNKNOWN. Astra cards retain their source-derived unreviewed status.
